english.title: Aggravated burglary with intent - other than dwelling
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having entered as a trespasser

(A)_[a building,]_
(B)_[part of a building,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), with intent to

(C)_[steal therein]_
(D)_[inflict grievous bodily harm upon a person therein]_
(E)_[do unlawful damage to the said building or anything therein]_

and at the time of committing the said burglary had with you

(F)_[a firearm,]_
(G)_[firearms,]_
(H)_[an imitation firearm,]_
(I)_[imitation firearms,]_
(J)_[a weapon of offence,]_
(K)_[weapons of offence,]_
(L)_[an explosive,]_
(M)_[explosives,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE TYPE OF FIREARM / WEAPON / EXPLOSIVE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 10(1) of the Theft Act 1968.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
entered as a trespasser a building/part of a building
with intent to steal therein/inflict grievous bodily harm on person therein/
do unlawful damage to building or anything therein
and at the time of burglary had in possession
firearm(s)/imitation firearm(s)/weapon(s) of offence/explosive(s)

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Mandatory drug test required if 18 or over
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also offence wording H2178 re dwellings only.
